remarks: This spacious and sunlit 3-bedroom apartment offers a rare opportunity to enjoy stunning views of the city skyline. Located in a well-maintained doorman building, this 1,646-square-foot home features 2.5 bathrooms and a versatile open floor plan, ideal for relaxation and entertaining. The apartment has been fully updated and is adorned with parquet flooring throughout, custom cabinetry and book shelves, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The beautifully updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, a new gas stove, and stainless-steel appliances, making meal preparation a pleasure. Wall unit heating and cooling systems ensure year-round comfort tailored to your preference. Additional conveniences include a laundry room just down the hall and an assigned & deeded parking space in the underground garage. The HOA covers utilities, excluding electric and WiFi. Situated in the heart of Stamford, this prime location puts you within walking distance of all the neighborhood's vibrant amenities, including downtown shops, restaurants, houses of worship, and public transportation.
